[1] (2, 6)
[2] (5, 4)
[3] (2, 4)
[4] (4, 4)
[5] (4, 6)
[6] (3, 3)
[7] (6, 4)
[8] (1, 5)
analysis:
- Player position: (2, 3)
- Boxes positions: (4, 3)
- Target positions: (2, 4)
Move sequence analysis:
Initial position: (2, 3)
Move 1 - Left: Player moves from (2, 3) to (2, 2)
Move 2 - Up: Player moves from (2, 2) to (1, 2)
Move 3 - Right: Player moves from (1, 2) to (1, 3)
Move 4 - Right: Player moves from (1, 3) to (1, 4)
Move 5 - Up: Failed - Wall in the way (Player stays at (1, 4))
Move 6 - Down: Player moves from (1, 4) to (2, 4)
Move 7 - Up: Player moves from (2, 4) to (1, 4)
Move 8 - Down: Player moves from (1, 4) to (2, 4)

Final position: (2, 4)

So the answer is (2, 4). The option number is 3.
